senses.gloss: reverse, opposite. לְשׁוֹן ה׳ a phrase which means the reverse (euphemism).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 2:2:4">Y. Naz. II, 51ᵈ</cite> bot. (ed. Krot. <he>הפר</he>, corr. acc.); ib. V, end, 54ᵇ <he>לָשׁוֹן הָפוּךְ</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 29b:15">B. Kam. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ה׳ למטה וכ׳</he> the term ‘upturning’ means a movement within three cubits (Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80).
